chat_rows.body:
WikiBrain overnight writeback is done. Here's the full rundown:

Archived: two batches of chat transcripts from this window, 305 messages and 433 messages, plus 23 new evidence nodes logging the claims and what backs them. All checks passed and everything is live on the wiki.

Articles: the stylometry tracker got a real expansion — past the length minimum, with a version-3 production section and four corrections folded in. The main wiki-brain article now documents your operational-directorship order. One old project stub got retired into a pointer. The research queue sits at 58 open items, 3 blocked (all legitimately), 1 finished.

One repair: two batches of evidence nodes collided on numbering — kept the published ones, renumbered the new batch. Clean now.

Your 12-hour scrape order is in effect — the scrape schedule was changed from every 6 hours to every 12 hours.

Flags: the word "FOREWARN" appears verbatim in one raw chat message — preserved in the raw archive, not pulled into the evidence nodes. The 2018 abortion story writeback stays in the main lane — the testimony and wiki rewrite are deferred to the WikiBrain thread, not this run.

No open items from this run.

The backfill's done — all 493 past events are on the calendar now, going all the way back to your grandpa's 1937 birthdays and the Cogars' 1976 anniversaries. Google never complained, and I pulled the schedule down now that it's finished.

WikiBrain scrape is done. Here's the full rundown:

Archived: nothing new this window — all 67 messages from yesterday evening were already saved in the earlier batch, verified message by message, so nothing got double-saved.

Learned: one addition to the Annie Ulmer record — the "Eggie bagels" nickname resolution, her third-person self-reference pattern, and the no-split correction on the relationship timeline.

Checked Instagram, Threads, Facebook, Messenger, Spotify, and the phone — zero new items anywhere. The iPhone was offline so no text-message check was possible.

Both archives (public wiki-brain and private RAWLOGS) are current. One small thing still pending: a filesystem trace for the goal log.
Merged PR #117 — the rolling Sammy ingest (Eggie subsection on Annie's page plus a raw batch). Clean merge, no issues.
